title: Track Guide: Circuit Zolder - Sept 11th, 2012

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: when the wall on the left ends, quickly jab on the brakes

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: when the gravel starts on the left, break a bit harder

corners.line: quick lift and back on the thrt

corners.label: T5
corners.line: don't touch the left curve, attack the right curb

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: right at the 100 met Mark, hard breaking
corners.exit: roll on the throttle slowly, avoid wheel spin

corners.label: T10
corners.exit: don't take too much of the curbing

general_tips: Track features many slow section chicanes and hains
Mechanical grip good breaking balance and traction out of slow sections are key
Good battles bits entry as those entering bits will be braking 100m later than those continuing on the track
turn five chicane is very bumpy, fight for traction all race long
